539-3821-4679-6495-6821.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two lands excluding Yenna that can tap for mana.
539-3821-4679-6495-6821.description:
Cause Peregrine Drake to become an enchantment using Jump Scare.
Activate up to four lands excluding Yenna by tapping them, adding at least {2}
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake
When the Peregrine Drake token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna and up to four other lands.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the Peregrine Drake token, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth.
Repeat from step 2.

3263-4779-6871--211.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the earthbend creature.
3263-4779-6871--211.description:
Cast the earthbend creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing the earthbent creature.
When the creature dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability, giving Krark-Clan Grunt +1/+0 and first strike until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.
3263-4779-6871--211.notes: Depending on the earthbend creature used, you may receive additional results. There may also be needed prerequisites that are specific for each card (such as Bumi, King of Three Trials which requires a Lesson in your graveyard).

969-5078-6918-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

997-1453-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
997-1453-4694-7306.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Arwen.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, scrying 1.
Repeat from step 1.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3169-3249-6006--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3169-3249-6006--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Enduring Vitality by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Enduring Vitality by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Genesis Chamber triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

4289-4687-5479.notablePrerequisites: Lost Jitte has at least three charge counters on it.
4289-4687-5479.description:
Activate Cryptolith Rite by tapping Gilder Bairn, producing its effect.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Lost Jitte.
Activate Lost Jitte two times by removing three charge counters from it, untapping two lands.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding {1}{G/U}.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Lost Jitte, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

4535-8095--5.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Good-Fortune Unicorn triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat

1129-3457-7791.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Allies.
1129-3457-7791.description:
Activate Harabaz Druid by tapping it, adding at least {2}
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting Harabaz Druid.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Seeker of Skybreak.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Harabaz Druid.
Repeat.

1619-4605-5542-5686-6150.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5542-5686-6150.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Tomb of Horrors Adventurer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Tomb of Horrors Adventurer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Tomb of Horrors Adventurer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Tomb of Horrors Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Tomb of Horrors Adventurer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Tomb of Horrors Adventurer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Tomb of Horrors Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Tomb of Horrors Adventurer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4605-5542-5686-6150.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

997-3605-4812-5987.description:
Cast Animate Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Animate Dead enters, it trigger, returning Angel of Indemnity from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Animate Dead to it.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, targeting Dance of the Dead.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Angel of Indemnity.
Resolve the Angel of Indemnity trigger, returning Dance of the Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dance of the Dead enters, it trigger, returning Angel of Indemnity from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Dance of the Dead to it.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, targeting Animate Dead.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Angel of Indemnity.
Resolve the Angel of Indemnity trigger, returning Animate Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1334-1517-2034-3029.easyPrerequisites: The Mirari Conjecture's third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
1334-1517-2034-3029.description:
Cast Seasonal Ritual either from your hand or from your graveyard for its flashback cost by paying {G}.
The Mirari Conjecture triggers, copying Seasonal Ritual.
Resolve both Seasonal Rituals, adding {G}{G} and then exiling the original Seasonal ritual with the ability to cast it from exile later.
Cast Rosethorn Acolyte from exile by paying {2}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Rosethorn Acolyte.
Repeat.

1563-2351-6460-7060.easyPrerequisites:
You control a token.
It is an opponent's turn.
1563-2351-6460-7060.description:
Activate Hardened Tactician by paying {1} and sacrificing a token.
If you sacrificed a Tentacle, The Watcher's second ability triggers if the creature token was a Tentacle, untapping a Kraken and putting a stun counter on up to one nonland permanent.
Resolve the Hardened Tactician ability, causing you to draw a card.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Activate the Tentacle by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat.

4050-4766-6990.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Michelangelo.
When Michelangelo dies, it and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve the Michelangelo trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting Michelangelo from your hand onto the battlefield and attaching Deathrender to it.
Repeat.

1017-3532-3581-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Wizard Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Kykar triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Activate Kykar by sacrificing the Spirit, adding {R}.
Repeat.

792-3705-5231-6896.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
When Squee dies, Totentanz triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature token, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R} due to Green Goblin.
Repeat.

3234-3293-5226-5256.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
3234-3293-5226-5256.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat
3234-3293-5226-5256.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

4067-4435-5042-6827.easyPrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
4067-4435-5042-6827.description:
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, tapping Spider-Gwen.
Spider-Gwen triggers, causing you to discard a card and draw four cards.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Spider-Gwen.
Repeat.

261-3197-4017.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
261-3197-4017.description:
Gain life.
Sunbond triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1363-1636-4939.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature,
1363-1636-4939.description:
Cast Burning-Tree Emissary by paying {R/G}{R/G}
When Burning-Tree Emissary enters the battlefield, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Burning-Tree Emissary trigger, adding {R}{G}.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate Tradewind Rider by tapping it, Burning-Tree Emissary and one other creature you control, returning Burning-Tree Emissary from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
1363-1636-4939.notes: If you control creature(s) that can tap to produce mana, you can use that mana to pay for the creature and instead gain mana from the creature's ETB ability.

1496-3490-4659-6283.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
1496-3490-4659-6283.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Verdant Sun's Avatar indestructible.
1496-3490-4659-6283.description:
Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Amalia triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Repeat from step 3.

654-1170-1770-2733-5954.description:
Cast Shimmering Wings by paying {U}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere land tokens enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping them.
Resolve the Shimmering Wings spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Shimmering Wings by paying {U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1069-2457-4359-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-2457-4359-5499.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Insect.
Activate the Insect by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may repeat step 1 as desired.

1807-2792-3489.notablePrerequisites:
Moonsnare Specialist does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{B}.
1807-2792-3489.description:
Declare Moonsnare Specialist as an attacker.
When it isn't blocked, activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{B}.
Activate Great Whale's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{B} and returning Moonsnare Specialist from the battlefield to your hand, putting Great Whale onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Moonsnare Specialist's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U} and returning Great Whale from the battlefield to your hand, putting Moonsnare Specialist onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Moonsnare Specialist enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning up to one creature to its owner's hand.
Repeat from step 2.
If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{B}, this combo nets infinite mana.

678-2034-2929.notablePrerequisites:
You have an enchantment creature card in hand.
You control at least six enchantments.
You have enough mana to cast the enchantment creature.
678-2034-2929.description:
Cast the enchantment creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Composer of Spring triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the enchantment creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the enchantment creature dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning the enchantment creature to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Composer of Spring trigger from step 2, putting the enchantment creature onto the battlefield from your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

262-859-5070.notablePrerequisites:
Lurking Roper does not have summoning sickness.
Elemental Mastery attached to Lurking Roper.
262-859-5070.description:
Activate Lurking Roper by tapping it, creating four 1/1 Elemental creature tokens.
When the Elementals enter the battlefield, they trigger Angelic Chorus four times.
Resolve the first Angelic Chorus trigger, causing you to gain one life.
Lurking Roper triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

638-1170-1470-4074.description:
Cast any other spell, or wait for an opponent to cast one.
If you cast the spell, Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Chandra.
Cast Hinder by paying {1}{U}{U}, targeting that spell.
Chandra, Displacer Kitten and Thrumming Stone trigger.
Resolve the Chandra trigger, creating a copy of Hinder, targeting the original Hinder.
Resolve the copy of Hinder, countering the original Hinder and putting it on top of your library.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Chandra.
Resolve the Thrumming Stone trigger from step 3, revealing the top four cards of your library and casting Hinder without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 4.

147-1567.easyPrerequisites: There are legal target(s) for Momentary Blink.
147-1567.description:
Cast Momentary Blink by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Momentary Blink, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Momentary Blink, blinking Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.

399-678-4465.description:
Sacrifice Metallic Sliver to its ability, adding {B}{B}.
Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Metallic Sliver from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Metallic Sliver.
Repeat.
